summary: You can now see how Copilot code review feedback lands in each repository. A new “Repository insights” page, the first item in a repository’s Insights tab, brings Copilot code review outcomes together in one place.
takeaways: Enterprise owners and billing managers, organization owners, and anyone with a custom organization or enterprise role that grants the View Copilot Metrics permission can access the repository 1-day reports through the API.
The same metrics are also available in the enterprise and organization repository 1-day reports ( repos-1-day ) in the Copilot usage metrics API.
Use these insights to find repositories with coverage gaps and focus enablement where it will have the most impact.
